title: DatasetLabels
description: Standard label schema for binary detection (Objective 2) and multi-class family classification (Objective 3). Note: Multi-class values represent the initial baseline taxonomy and remain subject to final Phase 1 collection results per PROJECT_MANUAL.md.

binary_label_name.description: Canonical string representation of binary verdict

family_label.description: Multi-class integer code. Initial project mapping: 0=Benign, 1=PowerShell Fileless, 2=WMI Malware, 3=Process Hollowing, 4=Reflective DLL Injection, 5=Registry Malware. Open to extension based on final Phase 1 collections.

family_name.description: Canonical malware family or class name (e.g. 'Benign', 'PowerShell Fileless', 'Cobalt Strike Beacon', etc.)

mapping_status.description: Tracks whether the taxonomy is the initial baseline or the finalized post-collection taxonomy
